newsitem.title: GREECE: Drachma stable vs ecu, depos, forwards, bonds idle.
newsitem.headline: Drachma stable vs ecu, depos, forwards, bonds idle.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were steady-to-easier around mid-session, ecu/drachma was locked in the 309.28/36 band and bonds were idling with market participants looking forward to Tuesday's auction, dealers said.
"Depos and forex forwards are stable to easier in quiet trading," said a dealer at a foreign bank.

Other dealers said they expected the central bank to leave more liquidity in the system on Wednesday and more funds to come in from foreign investors who buy into OTE's part-float part-flotation which ends on Friday.

"Players in London are loaded with drachmas and it will be interesting to see what they will do with the funds," said a private bank dealer. "This could possibly explain why the central bank does not inject more funds into the market via its 14-day depo tender."
FRNs and fixed coupon bonds were little changed in quiet mid-session dealings and dealers were also looking forward to Tuesday's auction.
"There is very little movement in prices," said a bond dealer. "The market is quiet awaiting Tuesday's auction."
There will be buying interest for the bellwether 10-year bond but it will be less than anticipated a few weeks ago, the dealer said.
Greece will auction 100 billion drachmas of 10-year, 8.80 percent fixed coupon bonds on Tuesday. It is the first ever issue of 10-year bonds.
It will also re-open bids for three-, five- and seven-year bonds the same date. Fifty billion drachmas for each maturity will be auctioned.
The mark was quoted at 158.50/55 from Thursday's 158.755 fix, the dollar at 273.96/06 drachmas from 273.660 and the ecu at 309.31/41 from 309.160 drachmas.

"Ecu/drachma is oscillating in the 309.25/40 corridor," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank. "Mark/drachma buying accounted for the slight rise of the ecu versus the drachma in late Friday trading."
